sheet.bends.summary: Compute a sheet-metal bend table: neutral radius and developed length per bend from an explicit K-factor or bend allowance, plus bend directions and process metadata. Bend allowance is never guessed.

inputs.segments: Nonempty array of {type:flat,length} and {type:bend,radius,angle,axis?,K?|allowance?} segments; every bend declares exactly one of K or allowance.
inputs.representation: external (default) or native; native flat-pattern API is a gated availability.

limitations: Bend allowance is never guessed: a bend missing both K and allowance is rejected. This is an external recipe; the native flat-pattern API is gated and not faked.

sheet.form.summary: Form declared sheet segments into 3D neutral-axis geometry and produce the flat layout, bend table and flat-to-formed correspondence using an explicit external representation.

inputs.segments: Nonempty array of flat/bend segments (as sheet.bends).
inputs.representation: external (default) or native; native is reported blocked, never faked.

limitations: External recipe geometry only; the public native flat-pattern API is gated and reported blocked when requested. An arbitrary solid body is not unfolded; FPC is not sheet metal.

sheet.flat.summary: Produce the flat layout and developed length of declared sheet segments; developed length equals formed neutral length with no scaling, and bend directions are reported.

inputs.segments: Nonempty array of flat/bend segments (as sheet.bends).
inputs.representation: external (default) or native; native is reported blocked, never faked.

limitations: External flat layout only; no DXF/SVG export and no native flat-pattern associativity. Developed length equals formed neutral length and is never scaled.
